entries.Original: On by default. entries.Translated: 默认开启。当制作材料已拥有但存放在雇员身上时，召集小队会走 Artisan 的雇员取回流程（传唤铃 -> 雇员 -> 委托物品 -> 取回）将其移入背包，然后制作。需要 Artisan 和 AllaganTools，且你必须站在传唤铃旁。关闭：LazyCrafter 仅提示你手动取回什么。

entries.Original: Walk to the nearest summoning bell when a fetch needs one, or when a run ends blocked on your own market listings
entries.Translated: 当取回需要传唤铃，或运行因你自己的市场挂单受阻而结束时，走向最近的传唤铃

entries.Original: On by default (cards t_35be7be5 and t_034884f4). Two trips share this toggle. (1) When a craft's materials are on the retainers and no summoning bell is reachable, Dispatch queues the work and walks the character to the bell via Lifestream's 'go to market board' (/li mb) instead of refusing at the button - the fetch starts once a bell is actually reachable, and if the bell is still unreachable after 3 minutes the fetch is refused once in red. (2) When a run ENDS blocked on your own market listings, LazyCrafter sends you to the bell the same way so the listings can be pulled. Never mid-craft, never on a clean run. Off: no walking - a fetch without a bell is refused at press time, and a listing-blocked run just prints the summary. Either way, '/lcraft blocked' reprints the full detail.
entries.Translated: 默认开启（卡片 t_35be7be5 和 t_034884f4）。两种行程共用此开关。(1) 当制作材料在雇员身上且无法到达传唤铃时，召集小队会排队该工作并通过 Lifestream 的“前往市场布告板”(/li mb) 将角色走向传唤铃，而非在按钮处直接拒绝——一旦传唤铃实际可达便开始取回，若 3 分钟后传唤铃仍不可达则一次性以红色拒绝取回。(2) 当运行因你自己的市场挂单受阻而结束时，LazyCrafter 会以同样方式将你送往传唤铃以便撤下挂单。绝不在制作中途，绝不在顺利运行时。关闭：不走路——无传唤铃的取回在按下时即被拒绝，挂单受阻的运行仅打印摘要。无论哪种，'/lcraft blocked' 都会重新打印完整详情。

entries.Original: Walk to gil vendors during a cart run, one vendor per stop (buy, press Resume, next vendor)
entries.Translated: 在购物车运行期间走向金币商人，每站一个商人（购买、按继续、下一个商人）

entries.Original: On by default. When a cart is missing gil-vendor items, the run walks the character to the vendor NPCs - one vendor per stop, exactly like the summoning-bell walk: teleport to the nearest aetheryte, map flag, shopping line. Buy at the NPC, press Resume, and the run re-plans and walks to the next vendor. It never buys anything itself and never fires mid-craft. If Lifestream is missing, busy, or the teleport is refused, the stop falls back to flagging the vendor on the map and naming it in chat - the behaviour before this toggle existed. Off: vendors are flagged on the map only; buy at each and press Resume.
entries.Translated: 默认开启。当购物车缺少金币商人物品时，运行会走向商人 NPC——每站一个商人，与传唤铃行走完全一致：传送到最近的以太之光、地图标记、购物路线。在 NPC 处购买，按继续，运行会重新规划并走向下一个商人。它绝不自行购买任何东西，也绝不在制作中途触发。若 Lifestream 缺失、忙碌或传送被拒绝，该站会回退为在地图上标记商人并在聊天中指明——即此开关存在前的行为。关闭：仅在地图上标记商人；在每个商人处购买并按继续。

entries.Original: Prefer a currency shop over the market board when you can already afford it
entries.Translated: 当已能负担时，优先选择货币商店而非市场布告板

entries.Original: On by default (card t_b431de3a). Many materials are sold by currency vendors - beast-tribe traders, Grand Company quartermasters, scrip counters - for seals, tokens or tomestones rather than gil. LazyCrafter now reads those shops and will send you to one INSTEAD of the market board, but only when it resolves to a named NPC standing in a zone you can teleport to AND your balance of that currency already covers the price; the cheapest affordable offer wins. If anything is missing or you cannot afford it, the item stays on the market board exactly as before - it will never make a trade you cannot pay for, and it will never leave a material with no source. Off: currency vendors are still NAMED on the shopping list, you just keep buying on the board.
entries.Translated: 默认开启（卡片 t_b431de3a）。许多材料由货币商人出售——蛮族商人、大国防联军军需官、票据柜台——用军票、代币或诗学神典石而非金币购买。LazyCrafter 现在会读取这些商店，并把你送到那里而非市场布告板，但仅当它解析到位于你可传送区域内的具名 NPC 且你的该货币余额已足够支付价格时；最便宜的可负担报价胜出。若有任何缺失或你无法负担，物品仍像以前一样留在市场布告板——它绝不会进行你无法支付的交易，也绝不会让材料失去来源。关闭：货币商人仍会在购物清单上具名，你只是继续在市场布告板购买。

entries.Original: Run shopping stops first (buy, press Resume, then unattended)
entries.Translated: 先执行购物站点（购买、按继续、然后无人值守）

entries.Original: On by default (0.1.7.0). A cart run takes its user-intervention-requiring parts first: each shopping stop (gil vendor, market board, currency shop, manual source) is named in chat and on the Run tab exactly once - buy what is named and press Resume (Run tab button, /lcraft resume, or the copied report). When the run believes the rest of the cart needs no player, it goes unattended and behaves exactly as before. Off: the run is one continuous wave loop, identical to every version before 0.1.7.0.
entries.Translated: 默认开启（0.1.7.0）。购物车运行会先执行需要用户介入的部分：每个购物站点（金币商人、市场布告板、货币商店、手动来源）在聊天和运行标签页中各具名一次——购买所具名的物品并按继续（运行标签页按钮、/lcraft resume 或复制的报告）。当运行认为购物车其余部分无需玩家时，它会转为无人值守并像以前一样运行。关闭：运行为单一连续循环，与 0.1.7.0 之前的每个版本相同。

entries.Original: Buy vendor items through Knightshopper during a dispatch (one attempt, target totals)
entries.Translated: 在召集小队期间通过 Knightshopper 购买商人物品（一次尝试，目标总量）

entries.Original: On by default (0.1.7.7). When a dispatch is missing materials that a vendor sells - gil vendors, and currency vendors priced in one currency Knightshopper supports - the run hands the list to Knightshopper's purchase IPC instead of stopping at each vendor: grouped by currency, bought to TARGET inventory totals (a repeat dispatch asks for the same target at most, so nothing is bought twice). The run prints the list and its estimated cost before anything is spent. Market-board items are never routed, and one attempt per group means a refusal never retries. TWO switches must be on for a purchase to start: this one, and LazyCrafter on Knightshopper's allowed-plugins IPC list - that list lives in Knightshopper's settings (IPC permissions); LazyCrafter never changes it. If Knightshopper is missing, busy, not allowed, or has no vendor for an item, those items fall back to the usual shopping stops - flagged and named in chat as before. Off: the run behaves exactly like every version before 0.1.7.7 - every vendor item is flagged and named, nothing is bought automatically.
entries.Translated: 默认开启（0.1.7.7）。当召集小队缺少商人出售的材料时——金币商人，以及以 Knightshopper 支持的单一货币定价的货币商人——运行会将清单交给 Knightshopper 的购买 IPC，而非在每个商人处停下：按货币分组，购买至目标库存总量（重复召集最多请求相同目标，因此不会重复购买）。运行会在花费任何东西之前打印清单及其预估费用。市场布告板物品绝不会被路由，每组一次尝试意味着拒绝后绝不重试。购买开始需开启两个开关：此开关，以及 Knightshopper 允许插件 IPC 列表中的 LazyCrafter——该列表位于 Knightshopper 的设置（IPC 权限）中；LazyCrafter 绝不会更改它。若 Knightshopper 缺失、忙碌、未允许或没有某物品的商人，这些物品会回退到常规购物站点——像以前一样在聊天中标记并具名。关闭：运行与 0.1.7.7 之前的每个版本完全相同——每个商人物品都被标记并具名，不会自动购买任何东西。

entries.Original: After Artisan finishes a cart, print /pricematch (Lazy Market Companion) instructions for listing the results
entries.Translated: Artisan 完成购物车后，打印 /pricematch（Lazy Market Companion）上架结果的说明

entries.Original: Optional, never forced (Scope §0 item 6). Prints what was crafted and the /pricematch instructions to chat when a cart finishes; the sell list itself is not automated (Lazy Market Companion has no IPC for it). /pricematch still works - Lazy Market Companion answers it as a legacy alias.
entries.Translated: 可选，绝不强制（范围 §0 第 6 项）。购物车完成时在聊天中打印所制作的内容及 /pricematch 说明；出售清单本身不自动化（Lazy Market Companion 没有对应的 IPC）。/pricematch 仍然有效——Lazy Market Companion 会将其作为旧版别名响应。
